shadowSentences: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
My favorite movie is a science fiction film.
Traveling helps me to understand different cultures.
I usually go for a run in the morning.
Cooking new recipes is a fun way to spend weekends.
Listening to music can improve my mood instantly.
I love visiting museums to learn about history.
Photography allows me to capture beautiful moments.
Volunteering at the shelter has taught me a lot about empathy.
Learning a new language opens up many opportunities for communication.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable trip you have taken?
Q2: What challenges did you face while traveling?
Q3: How do you feel travel impacts personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give to someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: What steps do you take to be more environmentally friendly?
Q2: What challenges do people face when trying to be eco-conscious?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is it to protect the environment?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to others about reducing waste?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about effective study methods.
questions: Q1: What study technique works best for you?
Q2: Have you encountered any obstacles while studying?
Q3: How do you think effective studying affects academic performance?
Q4: What tips would you offer to students struggling with their studies?
